header.description: Public-workflow-derived service DAG based on the 22-task SRA-Search WfInstances structure: one reference-build task, ten read-extraction tasks, ten alignment tasks, and one merge task.

metadata.author: Peng Li
metadata.derivation: task-level service DAG preserving the 3-layer, 20-path fan-out/fan-in structure; r and xi are normalized and clipped resource factors for DCNC-DAG simulation
metadata.notes: 10 sample branches; build_reference and fasterq_dump tasks are source functions; merge_alignments is the sink function

srasearch22.parameter_basis: Fixed normalized simulation factors recovered from the released input; no historical runtime/byte conversion is documented.

header.description: Public-workflow-derived service DAG based on Pegasus SIPHT Run 1. It uses the 31 task names from the public run and reconstructs the task-level dependency pattern from the Pegasus DAG graph.

metadata.author: Peng Li
metadata.derivation: task-level service DAG preserving the public run task names, Patser fan-in, Blast branch, SRNA merge, and final SRNA annotation stage; r and xi are normalized simulation factors
metadata.notes: 31 service functions; many source functions are used because the Pegasus task graph omits the non-task create_dir node; SRNA_annotate_ID000030 is the service sink

sipht31.parameter_basis: Fixed normalized simulation factors recovered from the released input; no historical runtime/byte conversion is documented.
